user.title: HYMER Connect Metadata Anmeldung
user.description: Gib deine HYMER Connect Zugangsdaten ein. Erstelle und installiere zuerst das lokale Runtime-Metadatenpaket und verwende dann dieselbe E-Mail-Adresse und dasselbe Passwort wie in der HYMER Connect App.

select_vehicle.title: Fahrzeug auswählen
select_vehicle.description: Wähle aus, welches Fahrzeug als eigener Home Assistant Eintrag hinzugefügt werden soll. Du kannst den aus der App extrahierten Remote-Access-Token jetzt oder später über Neu konfigurieren hinzufügen.

data_description.ehg_refresh_token: Wird für Live-SignalR-Telemetrie und Steuerung benötigt. Du kannst das Feld vorerst leer lassen und den Token später über das Menü des Konfigurationseintrags hinzufügen.

reauth_confirm.title: [%key:common::config_flow::title::reauth%]
reauth_confirm.description: HYMER Connect Metadata muss dein Konto erneut authentifizieren.

reconfigure.title: Remote Access Token aktualisieren
reconfigure.description: Set the EHG remote-access refresh token for this vehicle. Either paste one you already have, or mint one over Bluetooth: enter the vehicle's QR activation-code text and the SCU's Bluetooth address, press the CONNECTION button on the vehicle, then submit. Leave all fields blank to remove the stored token.

data.qr_token: QR activation token (to pair over Bluetooth)
data.ble_address: SCU Bluetooth address (to pair over Bluetooth)

data_description.qr_token: The text encoded in the vehicle's QR code. Only needed to mint a token over BLE.
data_description.ble_address: The SCU's Bluetooth MAC, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF. Only needed to mint a token over BLE.

init.title: Anzeige- und Debugoptionen
init.description: Konfiguriere optionale Debug-Entitäten und Anzeigeeinheiten für diesen Fahrzeugeintrag.

data.ble_mode: Bluetooth mode (fallback = cloud first; primary = BLE first)
data.apk_url: HYMER app APK URL (to auto-build the metadata pack)
data.provision_metadata: Rebuild metadata from the APK now

data_description.ble_address: The SCU's Bluetooth MAC, e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
data_description.ble_mode: fallback: try the cloud first and BLE only when the cloud fails (home HA near the van). primary: try BLE first, cloud as backup (a van-local HA).
data_description.apk_url: Direct download URL of a HYMER Android APK — the link must return the .apk file itself (e.g. from APKPure/APKMirror). Tick the box to download it and rebuild the local metadata pack in place, no external tools needed.

provision.title: Build metadata from a HYMER APK
provision.description: Paste a direct download URL of a HYMER Android APK (the link must return the .apk file itself, e.g. from APKPure/APKMirror). Home Assistant will download it and build the local metadata pack in-place — no external tools needed — then reload the integration.

data_description.apk_url: Must return the .apk file itself, not an HTML page.

error.apk_url_required: Enter the APK URL to build the metadata.
error.provision_failed: Could not build metadata from that APK. Check the URL returns a HYMER .apk file and try again.
